openAndNamed.thirdPartyDependency: the engine answers every /mod/tinymce_editor/... request with a 302 to https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/tinymce/5.10.7/... (deploy/bunny-worker-src/bunny-edge-engine-handler.ts:375-387, TINYMCE_DIST_BASE at :105), so a page's load event waits for the public internet. Run 2's C20 navigation timeout (30 s) is that dependency showing: the engine served the URL 200 in 797 ms and 810 ms, and the wait was on the redirect target. The repo vendors the mod's own scripts but not the TinyMCE distribution, so the harness cannot serve them locally without a copy it does not have. Operator call: mirror the distribution into the harness, or point the deck's editor base at an asset host the deployment controls.
openAndNamed.machineLoad: the 9. timings leg now measures a host that serves the engine one request at a time, so the number it reads is the page's own work; a machine stalled by the sibling lanes still inflates that wall, and the budget still sees it.
